name: rampnet-benchmark
description: Post-publication, human-verified curb ramp detection benchmark for RampNet: 9 city splits (1,109 reviewed panoramas) across Google Street View and Mapillary imagery, including two non-US cities. Per panorama, every RampNet detection was judged by a reviewer and ramps the model missed were marked, so both precision and recall are measurable. This benchmark is NOT part of the RampNet paper: it was built 2026-07-22 to 2026-08-01, eleven months after publication, and its ground truth, cities and matching protocol differ, so its numbers are not comparable with the paper's.

geocr:samplingStrategy: Each city split is stratified: 5 top-detection panoramas, N random and M empty (no-detection) panoramas drawn from a run of the auto-labeler over the city (benchmark/README.md; bend samples 10 empty where the others take 25). The per-row `review_group` records the stratum; the unbiased subset is random + empty. Only reviewed panoramas are included.
geocr:spatialBias: Nine splits: seven small US cities or districts and two non-US (Budapest District V, Sao Paulo). Five splits use Mapillary imagery (cameras: GoPro Fusion, GoPro Max, Trimble MX7, iSTAR Pulsar), four use Google Street View; imagery source and camera are confounded with city. Bend is one of the paper's three training cities.
rai:dataCollection: For each city, the sidewalk-auto-labeler enumerated panoramas, ran the published RampNet model (`model_id` rampnet-model) and exported a native-resolution bundle; a stratified sample was reviewed in RampNet's ground-truth gallery (scripts/gt_gallery.py) at 4096x2048: every detection judged, and the whole panorama scanned for missed ramps. Reviews were exported between 2026-07-22 and 2026-08-01 (verdicts.json `exported_at`). Protocol: docs/adding_a_benchmark_city.md.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Street-level panoramas from Google Street View and Mapillary, fetched by ProjectSidewalk/sidewalk-auto-labeler; per-record provider attribution is in `copyright`. Pixel hashes pinned at review time are in benchmark/<city>/imagery_manifest.json.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: benchmark/RUBRICS.md section 1: per detection one of correct / incorrect / unsure / duplicate; missed ramps marked with an optional unsure flag; a complete-scan attestation (`no_missed`). `unsure` is an ignore region for scoring. Scoring: scripts/score_validation.py and rampnet/detection_eval.py.
rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: RampNet ground-truth gallery (scripts/gt_gallery.py), a static HTML page.
rai:annotationsPerItem: One human review pass per panorama; no second rater has been run on any split yet (benchmark/README.md; a Budapest second rater is issue #74).
rai:dataBiases: Model-anchored ground truth: reviewers judge RampNet's own detections and then add misses, so the ground truth is not independent of the model being evaluated (the 1,000-panorama manual gold set in rampnet-dataset is the un-anchored one). Imagery provider and camera vary by split and move precision (benchmark/README.md). Capture years span 2007-10 to 2026-07 and differ by split (split_extents record set). Budapest was reviewed at low self-rated confidence with a US-derived rubric.
rai:dataLimitations: Not the paper's evaluation; do not compare its numbers with the paper's. Bend overlaps the training set by four panoramas (6WC0hdAYRsSAcluKSs5iRg, 9kW9cxpuj7q8DMzf-ClrQQ, DJ8Zp111zu6KnMZz-0PHgQ, VgWpqFkTwCIROvM0z-DkOw), unflagged in the published rows (issue #127); dropping them moves bend P/R 0.954/0.758 to 0.956/0.753. Reviewer notes and per-split confidence live in git (verdicts.json `review_notes`), not in the Parquet rows. Budapest is single-rater, low confidence, and should not be pooled with the US splits. The two Laurens, IA splits are in git but not yet on the Hub. About 110 to 125 panoramas per split, so per-split intervals are wide. Points only; the benchmark has no ramp extents.
rai:dataUseCases: Intended: out-of-domain evaluation of curb ramp detectors (precision, recall, AP) across cities and imagery sources; score with scripts/score_validation.py. Not intended: training (the splits are small, and training on them removes the only held-out cities), or quoting as the RampNet paper's evaluation.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Street-level panoramas can show people, vehicles, licence plates and private buildings; images are stored as the exact source bytes, with no redaction added by this release. The `copyright` field of Mapillary records names the contributing user account.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Static release (isLiveDataset false) pinned at Hub revision 63d5ffd0e4b6795702db40be89ea4d9672d91ab5. Verdicts are revised in git and re-exported to the `records` config without touching image files. Proposed versioning (issue #150): major version on any data-file change, minor on metadata-only changes. Maintained by Project Sidewalk / the Makeability Lab, University of Washington, via https://github.com/ProjectSidewalk/RampNet/issues.

distribution.name: repo
distribution.description: The Hugging Face dataset repository. This description matches revision 63d5ffd0e4b6795702db40be89ea4d9672d91ab5 (2026-08-17); per-file hashes are in the file_manifest record set.

distribution.name: parquet-records
distribution.description: `records` config, one Parquet file per city split. The ground truth: per-panorama metadata, model detections with their human verdict, and reviewer-marked missed ramps. Reviewed panoramas only.

distribution.name: parquet-native
distribution.description: `native` config, one Parquet file per city split. The panoramas exactly as fetched, 4096 to 16384 px wide depending on city and imagery source.

distribution.name: parquet-4096x2048
distribution.description: `4096x2048` config, one Parquet file per city split. The same panoramas at the model's input size; what ground-truth reviewers saw.

distribution.name: parquet-galleries
distribution.description: `galleries` config, one Parquet file per city split. Crops of single detections shown in the operating-point A/B pass (314 crops).

recordSet.name: splits
recordSet.description: One split per city. Every split is an evaluation split; none is for training.

recordSet.name: records
recordSet.description: The ground truth: per-panorama metadata, model detections with their human verdict, and reviewer-marked missed ramps. Reviewed panoramas only. Regenerated from benchmark/<city>/records.jsonl + verdicts.json in git by scripts/export_benchmark.py; git is the source of truth.

field.name: split
field.description: Split name, parsed from the Parquet file's path in the repository.

field.name: pano_id
field.description: Panorama id. GSV and Mapillary ids are different id spaces; key on (city, pano_id) when mixing splits.

field.name: source
field.description: Imagery source as recorded by the fetcher: `launch` (Google Street View) or `mapillary`.

field.name: capture_date
field.description: Capture month, YYYY-MM.

field.name: lat
field.description: Panorama latitude, WGS 84 (EPSG:4326).

field.name: lng
field.description: Panorama longitude, WGS 84 (EPSG:4326).

field.name: camera_heading
field.description: Compass heading of the panorama's centre column, degrees clockwise from north, as reported by the imagery provider.

field.name: copyright
field.description: Per-record source attribution string, as served with the imagery.

field.name: label_type
field.description: Always `CurbRamp`.

field.name: model_id
field.description: Model that produced `detections`.

field.name: detections
field.description: Model detections, each judged by a human reviewer. `verdict` is correct, incorrect, unsure (abstention; an ignore point) or duplicate (a second hit on an already-counted ramp). benchmark/RUBRICS.md section 1.

field.name: missed
field.description: Curb ramps the reviewer marked that the model did not detect.

field.name: no_missed
field.description: Reviewer attested that the whole panorama was scanned and nothing was missed.

field.name: review_group
field.description: Sampling stratum of the panorama (top-detection / random / empty); the unbiased subset is random + empty (benchmark/README.md).

recordSet.name: native
recordSet.description: `native` config. The panoramas exactly as fetched, 4096 to 16384 px wide depending on city and imagery source. Join to `records` on pano_id.

field.name: pano_id

field.name: sha256

recordSet.name: split_extents
recordSet.description: GeoCroissant record-level spatial and temporal extent of each published split, derived from the committed benchmark/<city>/records.jsonl restricted to reviewed panoramas (the filter export_benchmark.py applies). Re-derived and checked by `python scripts/validate_croissant.py`. Coordinates are WGS 84 degrees rounded to 5 decimals; dates are capture months.

recordSet.description: Every Parquet file at Hub revision 63d5ffd0e4b6795702db40be89ea4d9672d91ab5, with its size and content hash. Checked against the live listing by `python scripts/validate_croissant.py --hub`.
